rounds: I'd pay a little more for an app with no adverts.
Subscriptions are better value than buying things one at a time.
Cookie banners do more harm than good.
A website or app has tricked me in the last year.
Designers should refuse work that tricks users, even if it costs them their job.
Buy now, pay later should be banned for people under 25.
Shopping online is more honest than shopping in a real shop.
Social media apps should be made less addictive by law.
